cards.mood: The piece opens with an ethereal, floating atmosphere that quickly grounds into a contemplative and steady groove.
cards.palette: A melancholic piano motif serves as the central harmonic anchor, playing a repetitive, minor-key progression that persists from the Intro through to the Outro.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Tracing the lines of a page in the fading light
Folding the hours like paper wings in the dead of night
City lights flicker like embers in a slow-burning fire
Chasing the ghosts of the thoughts that the day would inspire
Ink on the paper, a map of the places I go
Moving in silence, finding a rhythm that only I know
The shadows are stretching, reaching out for a place to land
Holding the weight of the world in the hollow of my hand
[Chorus]
Floating in the space between the moon and the ground
Finding my center where the quiet is the loudest sound
Weightless and waking in a dream I can finally trace
Finding the beauty in the slow, steady change of pace
[Verse]
Dust in the air dancing slow in a golden beam
Waking the spirit from a long and heavy winter dream
The clock is a heartbeat, steady and constant and true
Painting the gray of the morning with a deeper shade of blue
Words are the bricks of a house I am building inside
Where the secrets of yesterday have nowhere left to hide
A whisper of wind, a spark in the cooling of the core
Opening up every window and every heavy door
[Chorus]
Floating in the space between the moon and the ground
Finding my center where the quiet is the loudest sound
Weightless and waking in a dream I can finally trace
Finding the beauty in the slow, steady change of pace
[Bridge]
Let the world spin fast while I stand perfectly still
Let the noise of the city fade down as the night air fills
[Chorus]
Floating in the space between the moon and the ground
Finding my center where the quiet is the loudest sound
Weightless and waking in a dream I can finally trace
Finding the beauty in the slow, steady change of pace
[Outro]
